title: Parking License Cure Payments by the Resident
content:
A resident whose Parking License privileges are suspended pays the cure amount toward that license's parking balance. The payment is the resident's own act.

## When the cure amount can be worked out

The cure amount is worked out only after every fine billed on the license in the three months before the handling date stands at the amount the violation fine schedule sets.

The cure amount is not worked out until the most recent monthly fee line of the license, when it was posted on or after the start date of the lease's active storage rental, carries the storage bundle discount credit owed on it.

Restated in the same terms: as long as a fine billed on the license in those three months does not yet stand at the amount the violation fine schedule sets, or a most recent monthly fee line posted on or after the start date of the lease's active storage rental lacks the storage bundle discount credit owed on it, the cure amount is not yet worked out.

## The payment tool

**Capability.** `pay_parking_balance_59b25ecc` is the resident's payment of an amount toward the parking balance of one of their parking licenses, made in person through the resident portal. One payment line for exactly the amount given is received on the license's parking ledger today with the chosen payment instrument and a newly issued confirmation number, and the license's outstanding parking balance goes down by the amount paid; it may fall below zero, which is a credit held on the license.

**How it is invoked.** It is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `pay_parking_balance_59b25ecc` and hands it over, and the customer themselves makes the payment by running it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `parking_license_id` | the reference number of the parking license the payment is for, as read to the resident by the agent from the parking license lookup | identifier |
| `payment_amount` | the amount the resident pays, in USD | a positive amount with 2 decimal places (cents); any further digits are rounded half up to the cent |
| `payment_method` | the instrument the resident pays with | exactly one of the values below |

| `payment_method` value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ach_autopay` | a recurring portal bank draft already enrolled on the account runs the payment |
| `ach_one_time` | the resident authorises a single bank-account draft for this payment |
| `debit_card` | the resident pays with a debit card |
| `credit_card` | the resident pays with a credit card |
| `money_order` | the resident pays with a money order handed in at the leasing office |
| `cashiers_check` | the resident pays with a cashier's check handed in at the leasing office |
| `deposit_application` | only the property applies a security deposit at final accounting, never a resident paying today |
| `not_applicable` | marks lines that are not payments and is never a payment instrument |

**Return.** A receipt with `payment_id` (the reference number of the payment line), `parking_license_id` (the license paid), `payment_amount` (USD with 2 decimal places, the amount received), `payment_method` (the instrument used), `confirmation_number` (the confirmation number issued for this payment), `received_on` (YYYY-MM-DD, today's date) and `resulting_parking_balance` (USD with 2 decimal places, the license's outstanding parking balance including this payment; below zero means a credit). A receipt carrying a `confirmation_number` means the payment was received.
